name: Avram Garrison
description: De facto leader of Kjeldoran troops who formed the Knights of Stromgald; Varchild was his aide.

description_citations.text: "Varchild". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrison, aided by Lim-Dul, forms the Knights of Stromgald and attempts a coup, which fails; the Knights become zombified minions.
timeline.quote: The coup failed, and the Knights were turned into zombified minions of Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya discovers Avram Garrison's plot to overthrow King Darien and warns Varchild, Jodah and Gustha, who foil the coup.
timeline.quote: they manage to foil the coup

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final battle, Jaya defeats the zombie Belenda and Chaeska; Gustha is devoured by undead while Avram, distracting her, is killed by Varchild.
timeline.quote: Jaya fights and defeats Belenda Dannisdotter—now a zombie, and Chaeska

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Order, a front for Avram Garrison and Lim-Dul, stages a coup to assassinate King Darien; Jodah, Jaya Ballard, Gustha Ebbasdotter and Varchild foil it.
timeline.quote: Their staged coup was foiled by Jodah , Jaya Ballard , Gustha Ebbasdotter , and Varchild defending the king

citation.text: "Order of Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varchild rises to become aide to Avram Garrison.
timeline.quote: Varchild became a Captain in the Kjeldoran army and was appointed as Avram's aide.

citation.text: "Varchild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garrison forms the Knights of Stromgald to kill the king; Varchild refuses and defends the king with her life.
timeline.quote: Varchild could not go along with murdering the king of the nation
